description: This Dart source file defines the HomeScreen widget and related UI components for a Flutter-based learning app. It manages displaying a welcome header, progress summary, and a list of lesson cards, including loading states and navigation to lesson detail screens.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays the main home screen with lessons and progress overview.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class for HomeScreen managing data loading, UI state, and building the widget tree.

classes.name: _AnimatedAppear
classes.description: A widget that animates its child appearing with optional delay and motion reduction.

classes.name: _AnimatedAppearState
classes.description: State class managing animation controller and animation for _AnimatedAppear.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontal
classes.description: A widget representing an individual lesson card with progress indicator.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontalState
classes.description: State managing the pressed state and tap interactions of the lesson card.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and triggers data loading.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches lessons from the repository and updates the state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI tree for the HomeScreen, including header, progress, and lessons list.

methods.name: _AnimatedAppear
methods.description: Constructor for animated appearance with optional delay.

methods.name: initState (for _AnimatedAppearState)
methods.description: Sets up the animation controller and starts the animation based on delay and motion settings.

methods.name: build (for _AnimatedAppearState)
methods.description: Builds the animated widget with fade and translate effects.

methods.name: _LessonCardHorizontal
methods.description: Constructor for the lesson card widget.

methods.name: build (for _LessonCardHorizontalState)
methods.description: Constructs the lesson card UI, including hero animation, progress indication, and tap interactions.
